title: Cap. 7 Rat. 10: Adam parity contradicts Scripture’s sure purpose of good pleasure
pass_a_gloss: But this conflicts with sacred Scripture, which suspends grace and eternal life prepared and to be given in Christ to all who are to be saved from the sure purpose of the Divine good pleasure, not from a contingent motion of human choice; which will be shown in the controversy Concerning Election and Passing-by.
pass_b_english: But that clashes with Scripture. Scripture hangs the grace and eternal life prepared and to be given in Christ to all who will be saved on God's sure purpose of good pleasure, not on a contingent turn of human choice. The treatise on Election and Passing-by will show this.
source_text: At hoc repugnat sacrae Scripturae, quae gratiam & vitam aeternam in Christo omnibus salvandis praeparatam & donandam suspendit ex certo proposito beneplaciti Divini, non ex contingente motu arbitrii humani; quod in controversia De Electione & Praeteritione ostendetur.
